text:
Alicia Ramos: Quick idea — pilot to migrate 3 large metered accounts to 12mo committed private offers with a migration incentive (small upfront credit + lowered unit price).
Mike Chen: nice. what discount depth are we thinking and retention uplift target?
Alicia Ramos: aiming for ~15-20% effective vs current metered spend, expecting 30–40% ARR retention uplift over baseline for these accounts.
Ravi Patel: SI play is key — propose a one-time SI enablement credit (to cover integration + embeddings tuning) layered on top of the customer credit. helps close faster.
Sasha Liu: we need an announce cadence for joint customers. avoid broad marketplace banner until we validate metrics. co-marketing only for 1 pilot wave.
Jordan Price: flag from finance — credits need cap + clear treatment for revenue recognition. we can structure as prepaid consumption credit or true discount; both have different P&L timing.
Alicia Ramos: good point. prefer prepaid credit applied to committed bucket (simpler contract). cap = 20% of first-year commit. legal ok?
Mike Chen: if cap=20%, how do we handle overages? retain metered rates for overages or tiered pushback?
Ravi Patel: overages should bill at committed unit price + small throttle window. SI will expect a success milestone before their credit is paid out.
Sasha Liu: proposal for timeline: wk0 align pilots + contracts; wk2 enable SI + launch onboarding; wk6 evaluate metrics; wk8 decide scale.
Alicia Ramos: sample private offer terms (draft):
```
commit_amount: $250000
duration_months: 12
discount_vs_metered: 18%
migration_credit: $20,000 (applied to committed bucket)
si_enablement_credit: $10,000 (paid to SI on milestone)
overage_policy: billed at committed unit price + 10%
cap_on_credits: 20% of commit in year 1
```
Jordan Price: that structure looks workable. suggest we also require invoice schedule (2x or monthly) to align cash flow.
Mike Chen: who owns pilot GTM? I'll take sales owner on Customer A and Customer B. Ravi will own SI scope. Alicia will own marketplace/private-offer setup + partner negotiation.
Ravi Patel: noted — I'll prep SI runbook and checklist. need SKU mapping and embeddings quota mapped into committed bucket.
Sasha Liu: marketing — hold public announcements until pilot passes metrics, but prepare a co-sell one-pager and a joint case-study template.
Alicia Ramos: next steps: mike to confirm customer shortlist by EOD Thu, ravi to share SI runbook by Mon, jordan to draft finance treatment + contract clause. I'll draft private-offer template and a short pilot one-pager.
Mike Chen: sending shortlist now.
Ravi Patel: ack, will start runbook draft.
Jordan Price: I'll draft contract snippets and share a redline by Mon.
deploy-bot: Salesforce opps created for Customer A, Customer B, Customer C (links posted in #sales).
Alicia Ramos: thanks team — aim to have contracts signed with at least one pilot customer before month-end. :rocket:
